result.summary: The intersection features a marked zebra crosswalk and basic sidewalk infrastructure in a residential/mixed-use setting. While traffic signals are present, the environment lacks dedicated pedestrian signal heads and suffers from sightline obstructions due to parked vehicles near the crossing.

hazards.name: Visual Obstruction from Parked Cars
hazards.description: Vehicles parked close to the intersection on the right side block sight lines between approaching drivers and pedestrians waiting to cross.
hazards.location_in_image: Right side of the roadway, adjacent to the crosswalk

hazards.name: Faded Crosswalk Markings
hazards.description: The zebra markings are showing signs of wear, which reduces their visibility to approaching motorists.

interventions.title: Curb Extensions (Bulb-outs)
interventions.description: Extend the sidewalk into the parking lane to shorten the crossing distance and improve visibility between pedestrians and drivers.

interventions.title: Daylighting
interventions.description: Remove parking spaces immediately adjacent to the crosswalk to ensure clear sight lines.

interventions.title: Pedestrian Countdown Signals
interventions.description: Install dedicated pedestrian signal heads with countdown timers to provide clear information on crossing time.

result.summary: The image shows a residential intersection featuring a marked zebra crosswalk and a vehicle traffic signal. While basic pedestrian infrastructure like sidewalks and curb ramps are present, the environment lacks dedicated pedestrian signals and suffers from sightline obstructions due to parked vehicles and mature trees.

hazards.name: Sightline Obstruction (Parked Cars)
hazards.description: Parked vehicles on the left side of the street near the crosswalk may obscure pedestrians from the view of approaching drivers.
hazards.location_in_image: Left side of the street, upstream of the crosswalk.

hazards.name: Sightline Obstruction (Tree)
hazards.description: A large tree trunk on the left corner may partially block the view between pedestrians waiting to cross and oncoming traffic.

interventions.title: Daylighting
interventions.description: Remove parking spaces immediately adjacent to the crosswalk to improve visibility for both pedestrians and drivers.

interventions.title: Curb Extensions
interventions.description: Extend the sidewalk into the parking lane to shorten the crossing distance and place pedestrians in a more visible position before they enter the roadway.

interventions.title: Pedestrian Countdown Signals
interventions.description: Install dedicated pedestrian signals with countdown timers to provide clear information on when it is safe to cross.

result.summary: The pedestrian environment is characterized by narrow sidewalks directly adjacent to the roadway without a buffer zone. Crossing infrastructure is minimal, consisting only of a single faded transverse line, and lacks high-visibility markings or pedestrian signals.

hazards.name: Inadequate Crossing Markings
hazards.description: The lack of high-visibility crosswalk markings makes the pedestrian crossing point unclear to drivers and provides no dedicated space for pedestrians.

hazards.name: Lack of Pedestrian Buffer
hazards.description: The narrow sidewalk is immediately adjacent to the travel lane with no physical separation or buffer, increasing risk from passing vehicles.

hazards.name: Sidewalk Debris
hazards.description: Accumulated trash and debris in the gutter and on the sidewalk edge create minor trip hazards and reduce usable walkway width.

interventions.title: High-Visibility Crosswalk
interventions.description: Install continental-style crosswalk markings to clearly define the pedestrian path and increase driver awareness.

interventions.title: Curb Extensions
interventions.description: Construct bulb-outs at the intersection to shorten the crossing distance and improve visibility between pedestrians and motorists.

interventions.title: Pedestrian Countdown Signals
interventions.description: Add pedestrian-specific signal heads with countdown timers to provide clear information on when it is safe to cross.
